thirst.ponder.sand_filter.header: Purifying Water with a Sand Filter
thirst.ponder.sand_filter.text_1: A Sand Filter purifies by one step water pumped through it
thirst.ponder.sand_filter.text_2: Dirty Water needs to be pumped in from the top...
thirst.ponder.sand_filter.text_3: and Purified Water can be pumped out from the bottom
command.thirstwastaken.set: set thirst to %1$s, set quenched to %2$s
thirstwastaken.config.title: Thirst Was Taken
thirstwastaken.config.thirst_depletion_m: How fast thirst drains outside the Nether, before biome climate is applied.
thirstwastaken.config.nether_thirst_depl: Depletion speed used in the Nether and any other dimension where water evaporates.
thirstwastaken.config.fire_resistance_de: Percentage of the normal depletion speed applied while Fire Resistance is active.
thirstwastaken.config.thirst_depletion_i: When off, thirst slowly refills instead of draining on Peaceful difficulty.
thirstwastaken.config.depletes_when_naus: Adds extra thirst exhaustion while the Nausea effect is active.
thirstwastaken.config.dehydration_halts_: Blocks natural health regeneration while thirst is not full.
thirstwastaken.config.prevent_sprinting_: Stops sprinting once thirst drops to 6 or below.
thirstwastaken.config.can_drink_rain.too: Look straight up in the rain to drink.
Sneak and use an empty hand on water to drink directly from it.
thirstwastaken.config.drink_by_hand_need: Requires both hands to be empty before drinking by hand.
thirstwastaken.config.extra_hydration_co: Hydration above the maximum is turned into quenched instead of being lost.
thirstwastaken.config.hand_drinking_hydr: Hydration restored by one drink straight from a water source.
thirstwastaken.config.hand_drinking_quen: Quenched restored by one drink straight from a water source.
thirstwastaken.config.default_purity.too: Purity used for water that carries no purity of its own.
thirstwastaken.config.running_water_puri: Purity levels added when collecting from flowing water.
thirstwastaken.config.mountains_y.toolti: Water collected above this height counts as cleaner.
thirstwastaken.config.caves_y.tooltip: Water collected below this height counts as cleaner.
thirstwastaken.config.quench_when_debuff: Still restores thirst when the water poisons you.
thirstwastaken.config.nausea_chance.tool: Chance to catch Nausea and Hunger from water of this purity.
thirstwastaken.config.poison_chance.tool: Chance to be poisoned by water of this purity.
thirstwastaken.config.show_exhaustion_un: Draws the dotted AppleSkin-style exhaustion strip behind the thirst bar.
thirstwastaken.config.show_quenched_over: Draws the lighter quenched outline on top of the thirst droplets.
thirstwastaken.config.smooth_thirst_drai: Empties the draining droplet in quarters instead of jumping straight from full to half.
thirstwastaken.config.thirst_bar_x_offse: Horizontal offset of the thirst bar, in pixels.
thirstwastaken.config.thirst_bar_y_offse: Vertical offset of the thirst bar, in pixels.
thirstwastaken.config.enable_keyword_mat: Guesses hydration values for unknown modded items from their registry name.
thirstwastaken.config.note: Only HUD settings are client-side; the rest apply on the server.
